name: IEC 62660-1:2018 capacity test of EV propulsion lithium-ion cells at 23 +/- 2 C and at low temperature (-20 C option)
plain_name: Measure how much charge an electric-car battery cell delivers at -20 C
description: Performance test of secondary lithium-ion cells for BEV/HEV propulsion: discharge capacity measured at standard conditions (23 +/- 2 C) and optionally at low temperature (-10 C or -20 C); the -20 C option is used here. Cells are charged/discharged by a cycler while held in a temperature chamber.
keywords: Measure how much charge an electric-car battery cell delivers at -20 C

sources.citation: Battery Design, 'IEC 62660-1' (summary of IEC 62660-1:2018 Ed. 2.0, Secondary lithium-ion cells for the propulsion of electric road vehicles - Part 1: Performance testing)

requirements.rationale: Low-temperature capacity option at -20 C (253.15 K).
Reference capacity at the standard condition 23 C (296.15 K).
Discharge capacity is measured electrically, so the cell must be connected to the cycler inside the chamber.
Optional: the standard condition tolerance is +/-2 C, so the chamber should hold the set point within 2 K.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
